_comment: Curated free study material for openings.
'channels' are teachers whose material is free to watch. Caissa turns each one
into a channel-scoped search for the opening you are looking at, which is always
a valid link and always current — no dead video IDs, nothing invented.
'lectures' is for exact links you add yourself. Match an entry either by ECO
prefix ('B90', 'B9', 'B') or by a phrase that appears in the opening name.
Edit this file and the app picks it up immediately, no restart needed.
